title: Kummer descent of tame open direct images on entire normal-crossing strata
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology. Fix a finite intermediate field $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$. For $F=E$ or $\Omega$, let $C_F(S)=C(S,F)$ on profinite sets, using all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]; put $C_{F,T}=p_T^*C_F$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and their ordinary unbounded derived categories and direct images [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

Let $Y$ be a regular separated finite-type $k$-scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-regular-scheme], let $D=\bigcup_{a\in A}D_a$ be a reduced strict normal crossings divisor with finitely many components [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], and put $W=Y\setminus D$. Let $L$ be a finite-rank lisse $C_{E,W}$-module [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. Assume that on every strict henselization at a geometric point, with parameters $t_1,\ldots,t_r$ cutting out the branches of $D$, $L$ becomes constant on the inverse-limit cover of the complement obtained by adjoining compatible $n$th roots of all $t_i$ for every $n$ prime to $p$. This is the meaning of tame here; with no branches the cover is the identity. Write $L_F=C_{F,W}\otimes_{C_{E,W}}L$, an ordinary tensor, for $F=E,\Omega$.

Let $a:W\hookrightarrow Y$ be the open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For $I\subseteq A$, put $S_I=(\bigcap_{i\in I}D_i)\setminus\bigcup_{a\notin I}D_a$, with its reduced locally closed scheme structure, and write $s_I:S_I\to Y$. The intersection for $I=\varnothing$ is $Y$. There is a pro-etale covering family $u_\alpha:S_\alpha\to S_I$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], depending on $L$ but simultaneously valid for $F=E,\Omega$, on which compatible roots of unity identify the Kummer inertia group with $G_I=(\prod_{q\ne p}\mathbf Z_q)^I$. On each member there is a finite-dimensional continuous $E$-representation $M_\alpha$ of $G_I$, with finite prime-to-$\ell$ image of $H_I=(\prod_{q\ne p,\ell}\mathbf Z_q)^I$, and natural identifications
$$(s_Iu_\alpha)^*Ra_{*,C_F}(L_F[0])\ \cong\ p_{S_\alpha}^*R\Gamma_{G_I}(M_{\alpha,F}).$$
Here $M_{\alpha,F}$ is $S\mapsto C(S,F\otimes_E M_\alpha)$, and $R\Gamma$ is ordinary derived invariants of equivariant condensed modules, with action by the condensed group of all continuous maps into $G_I$. Pullbacks use the Cartesian coefficient identifications and are exact. The displayed identifications are the descent identifications induced by the augmented Kummer nerve: in degree zero the map is restriction of invariant sections, and its evaluation on the punctured strict-local cover is the actual direct-image counit. They commute with the map induced by $L_E\to\operatorname{Res}L_\Omega$, $x\mapsto1\otimes x$, and with scalar restriction; on the right this map is $p_{S_\alpha}^*$ of the map on derived invariants induced by $M_{\alpha,E}\to\operatorname{Res}M_{\alpha,\Omega}$. They are natural for restrictions of the covering family. If $I=\varnothing$, the description is just a pro-etale trivialization of $L_F$ on $W$. The formula is an assertion about restriction as a derived module sheaf on each stratum, not only about ordinary geometric stalks.
